Name: The Fauner - Faun Farmer
Author: poisonousbread33
Description:
[font=Courier New][size=4][b][i][center]The Fauner - Faun Farmer
[i]🦌
[/i][/center][/i][/b][/size][/font][center]This is a simple mod that adds two (technically four) new hairstyles with antlers, long ears, a small tail and a deer-like nose to the character creator. There are versions with long and short hair, both should fit any gender. Each has two versions with differently colored shading (warmer and colder). This doesn't replace any vanilla hairstyles and should be compatible with any other mods that add new hair.

I tested this and it seems to work fine, but this is my first Stardew mod so let me know if something's wrong or if these look weird with any animations![/center]

Manifest.Name: The Fauner - Faun Farmer
Manifest.Description: Hairstyles that make the farmer look like a faun.
